attr.title: The Amazing Spider-Man 2
attr.desc: Clean-room BYO-data loader for The Amazing Spider-Man 2 Android 1.2.7d/1.2.8d. Includes proven ARMHF routes plus a scoped AArch64 X5M/Box32 route, native controls and audio, persistent saves, the original first-run flow and transactional setup. Executable game data is not included.
attr.inst: Put a supported legal Android 1.2.7d/1.2.8d input in asm2_127/gamedata. A loose APK needs the matching intact cache ZIP or main.12032 plus patch.12723 OBB; patch.12438 is optional. The self-contained 1.2.8d installer needs no separate cache but is ARM32-only. Launch once and let NXExtract validate everything.
